description: JavaScript code for managing order shipping information UI interactions, including form validation, toggling display of edit/view modes, and handling shipping date display.

methods.name: showEdit
methods.description: Toggles visibility of edit and display elements for shipping info based on mode.

methods.name: restoreEditField
methods.description: Restores original values in edit fields.

methods.name: showShipByDate
methods.description: Shows or hides shipping date input based on selection.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Toggles between view and edit modes for shipping info display.
